tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Deepest background: behind modals, overlay, the 'space' around the app.

tokens.name: gray-90
tokens.usage: Base page background (app background).

tokens.name: gray-80
tokens.usage: Surface 1: cards, panels, navbar on top of gray-90.

tokens.name: gray-70
tokens.usage: Surface 2: card hover, inputs, nested blocks, popovers.

tokens.name: gray-60
tokens.usage: Dividers and thin borders, inactive chart tracks.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Visible control borders, disabled fills, inactive icons (3:1+ only on gray-100...80).

tokens.name: gray-40
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, secondary icons. 4.4:1 on gray-90, not for important text.

tokens.name: gray-30
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, labels, timestamps. About 6.8:1 on gray-90.

tokens.name: gray-20
tokens.usage: Body text on dark surfaces. About 10:1 on gray-90.

tokens.name: gray-10
tokens.usage: Headings, key metric numbers. About 14:1 on gray-90.

tokens.name: gray-0
tokens.usage: Lightest: accent text, text on colored buttons, light chip background.

tokens.name: red-default
tokens.usage: Error, critical metric: Default state. Button or badge fill with gray-100 text; status icon and text on gray-90/80 (>= 6:1).

tokens.name: red-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of red-default: one step darker, gray-100 text keeps >= 4.5:1.

tokens.name: red-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled state: muted red, low contrast on purpose. Text on it is gray-40.

tokens.name: orange-default
tokens.usage: Warning, metric out of range: Default state. Button or badge fill with gray-100 text; status icon and text on gray-90/80 (>= 6:1).

tokens.name: orange-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of orange-default: one step darker, gray-100 text keeps >= 4.5:1.

tokens.name: orange-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled state: muted orange, low contrast on purpose. Text on it is gray-40.

tokens.name: green-default
tokens.usage: Normal, success: Default state. Button or badge fill with gray-100 text; status icon and text on gray-90/80 (>= 6:1).

tokens.name: green-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of green-default: one step darker, gray-100 text keeps >= 4.5:1.

tokens.name: green-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled state: muted green, low contrast on purpose. Text on it is gray-40.

tokens.name: blue-default
tokens.usage: Information, neutral notices: Default state. Button or badge fill with gray-100 text; status icon and text on gray-90/80 (>= 6:1).

tokens.name: blue-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of blue-default: one step darker, gray-100 text keeps >= 4.5:1.
